title: The Estádio do Pacaembu is inaugurated, at a ceremony attended by President Getúlio Vargas.
text: The Estádio do Pacaembu, currently known as Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu for sponsorship reasons, is an association football stadium in São Paulo, Brazil. Located in the Pacaembu neighbourhood, it is owned by Municipal Prefecture of São Paulo.

title: President Getúlio Vargas signs a decree, establishing the country's minimum wage.
text: A minimum wage is the lowest remuneration that employers can legally pay their employees—the price floor below which employees may not sell their labor. Most countries had introduced minimum wage legislation by the end of the 20th century.

title: The Interlagos Circuit is inaugurated in São Paulo.
text: The Autódromo José Carlos Pace, better known as Interlagos, is a 4.309 km motorsport circuit located in the city of São Paulo, Brazil. It was inaugurated on 12 May 1940, by the federal intervener of the state of São Paulo, Adhemar de Barros.

title: date unknown - The minority Baenan language becomes extinct.
text: Baenã is a poorly attested, extinct, and unclassified language of Brazil. Only nine words have been attributed to the language.

title: Argila, directed by Humberto Mauro
text: Humberto Duarte Mauro was a Brazilian film director. His best known work is Ganga Bruta.
